note: The world before Genesis. Terrain is a pure function of the published seed; everything else is empty because nothing has happened yet. No part of this file is derived from an inhabitant.

notes: The verifier recomputes every event hash from the exported log and checks each event's prevHash against the previous event's recomputed hash.
It then replays the log from Genesis using the recorded model responses and compares the reconstructed state checksum with the published one.
It requires no credentials. Nothing it does can write to the world.
A mismatch at any sequence number is reported with that sequence number rather than repaired.
There is nothing to verify yet: this world has not begun.
